courses.title: Cybersecurity for the Agentic Era
courses.lead: A professional course for securing AI systems that plan, remember, delegate, call tools and run code: threat modelling, tool and MCP security, agent identity, sandboxing, runtime enforcement, red teaming and incident response.
courses.why: Agents read untrusted text and then act: they send, spend, change records and run code. That makes the model the wrong place to rely on for safety. This course is built on one rule: the model may propose an action, but independently enforced policy decides whether that action is allowed to affect the world.
courses.needs: Working knowledge of software or IT systems. Written for engineers, security practitioners and technical leads.
